name: IEX Cloud
tagline: Stock market data API for quotes, fundamentals, and financial datasets
description: IEX Cloud provides RESTful market data APIs covering equities, fundamentals, news, and related financial datasets. Developers authenticate with a publishable or secret token and call versioned HTTP endpoints for real-time and historical data. Pricing is usage-based with published free and paid tiers.

auth.details: API token as query parameter token=YOUR_API_KEY (or Authorization header). Self-serve signup for publishable and secret tokens.

use_cases: get real-time stock quote for a ticker
fetch company fundamentals and key stats
pull historical daily prices for a symbol
get latest market news for a stock
